title: Overview stacks four jobs: results, a WhatsApp invite card, a full inline Edit form and Privacy
where: /admin/sessions/[code] (Overview tab), 1440x900, session with themes; Edit session opened
what_happens: Below the results the page stacks a 'Send on WhatsApp' card, an 'Edit session' disclosure that opens a ~2,000px form inline (topic, both languages, intro, context, instructions, Status, prompt overrides, Save), and a Privacy row. With Edit open the page is about 2.5 screens and the results scroll away.
who_hurts: An admin who opens a session to read results gets three other jobs on the same screen; someone who wants to edit or close the session has to find a small disclosure at the bottom, and 'Status: open/closed' is buried inside the edit form.
suggested_fix: Keep Overview to Voices + Themes. Move Edit (with Status and Privacy inside it) to its own page or a 'Settings' tab in SessionHeader, opened by a small 'Edit' button in the header actions; make 'Send invites' a header button that opens the list picker in a dialog. page.tsx:254-298, whatsapp-invites.tsx:93.
rule: Dane's UI rule: 'One page, one main job ... Everything else on the page (creating, editing settings, adding to it) does not get its own big section stacked on the same screen: each becomes a button that opens its own page or dialog, or the jobs are split into tabs.'
origin: earlier: #7/#9 kept invites, edit and privacy on the overview
